T0577.title: Cookie Replay
T0577.definition: Reuse of a stolen session cookie to impersonate a user from another client or device.
T0577.description: Cookie replay uses stolen session cookies to restore a login session from another device or environment. It often combines infostealer malware, phishing proxies, or browser-data leaks. Defenses require device fingerprinting, token binding, session risk scoring, re-authentication for sensitive actions, and anomalous-location detection.
T0577.usageExample: Assess Cookie Replay related exposure and define the corresponding controls.
